name: com.mcx-ventures/aegis
title: AEGIS (McX Ventures)
description: Pay-per-call security checks, network forensics and same-day Pentagon contract awards, via x402.

tools.name: forensics_run
tools.description: No input: a reference scan of AEGIS's fixed basket of public hosts with all six checks (TLS, CT, DNS, NTP, portal, route), a baseline snapshot of network integrity from AEGIS's vantage. To scan your own hosts use forensics_custom. Result hash anchored on Base Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: forensics_custom
tools.description: Your targets: the same six checks (TLS, CT, DNS, NTP, portal, route) run against 1-8 public hosts or IPs you supply, in one call, a multi-target posture scan. Private and reserved addresses are rejected. Result hash anchored on Base Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: tls_check
tools.description: The certificate a server actually serves, one public host or IP: connects and reports issuer, validity and expiry, SANs, SHA-256 fingerprint and CA classification. Whether that certificate was publicly logged is ct_check. Result hash anchored on Base Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

target.description: Public hostname or IP address, e.g. example.com

tools.name: dns_check
tools.description: DNS hijack check, one domain: resolves it through AEGIS and through Cloudflare, Google and Quad9 and compares the answers by network owner (ASN), flagging private addresses and mismatches. Result hash anchored on Base Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

target.description: Public hostname (not an IP address), e.g. example.com

tools.name: ct_check
tools.description: Public logging of the live certificate, one domain: the certificate the server serves has its embedded SCTs verified against the known Certificate Transparency log list. Issuer and expiry are tls_check. Result hash anchored on Base Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

target.description: Public hostname (not an IP address), e.g. example.com

tools.name: dow_awards
tools.description: Defense-stock event signal: U.S. Department of War contract awards ($7.5M+) from the official 5 PM ET daily announcements, normally published the same evening, matched to public tickers and sized as % of the company's annual revenue (material / notable / routine), with action vs ceiling vs obligated dollars, new vs existing work and corrections. Each day's dataset hash is anchored on Base. Feed freshness is reported in every response and free at /dow-awards/index Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402.

date.description: One announcement day, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit all dates for the latest day.

ticker.description: Only awards whose awardee maps to this ticker, e.g. LMT.

min_tier.description: Minimum materiality tier (award vs annual revenue).
